title: Paper Cutout: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea lights and connects
scenes.purpose: Show a cut-paper idea (bulb) lighting a stack of paper sheets, then swinging out a pinned paper arm rig that fans into a connected system, closing on a readable caption card.
visuals: Night-indigo base sheet with three stepped lighter indigo cut-paper bands around the bulb
Sage ground sheet with cream edge
Terracotta bulb cutout with cream window, ink base plates and drawn filament
Ink paper strips joined by cream paper-fastener pins to sage, terracotta and ink node discs
Cream caption card with a hinged bottom flap and ink lettering

beats.development: Bulb cutout lowers onto the paper stack, pivoting on its base plates and settling.
Filament cut-line draws; three lighter indigo sheets drop in one after another around the bulb like stepped light.
Link arm swings out on the bulb's shoulder pin, carrying the first sage node into place.
Child arms fan open from the first node's pin, then grandchild arms open from their parents, forming the network.
Caption card is placed, its bottom flap unfolds from the back side, then its lettering appears once the card is complete.
Full composition holds settled for reading.

findings: Each development has one focal action; the rig cascades parent to child so eye trace runs left to right.
All motion settles by 2.43 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.43-3.0 s closing hold lets the five-word caption be read on a settled card.

notes: Background follows a scene-dependent stacked-sheet ramp; object colours keep the illustration's terracotta, sage, ink and cream assignments.
